name: Emperor Gaozu of Han
role: Founder and Emperor of Han Dynasty of China from 202 to 195 BC
legacy: He outmaneuvered rival rebel leader Xiang Yu to invade the Qin heartland and forced the surrender of the Qin ruler Ziying in 206 BC.

checks.lead: Emperor Gaozu of Han (256 or 247 – 1 June 195 BC), personal name Liu Bang, was the founder and first emperor of the Han dynasty.
